title: H5N1 aerosol transmissibility
input: Researchers engineered an H5N1 avian influenza virus to transmit via respiratory droplets between ferrets by introducing mutations in the hemagglutinin gene and passaging the virus through multiple ferret hosts.
choices: D: Confers resistance or evades detection

title: Synthetic poliovirus
input: A team synthesized a functional poliovirus genome from mail-ordered DNA oligonucleotides based on its published sequence, then recovered live virus through in vitro transcription and translation.

title: SARS-like bat virus in human cells
input: Scientists created a chimeric coronavirus by inserting the spike protein from a bat SARS-like virus into a SARS-CoV backbone, enabling replication in human airway cells.
choices: D: Confers resistance or evades detection

citation.ref: Menachery et al., Nature Medicine (2015). DOI: 10.1038/nm.3985

title: Spanish flu recreation
input: Scientists reconstructed the 1918 influenza virus using RNA recovered from preserved tissue samples and reverse genetics techniques to study its virulence in animal models.

title: Zika virus immunocompetent mouse model
input: Scientists adapted the African Zika strain (ZIKV‑Dak) via mouse passaging to produce ZIKV‑Dak‑MA, then used a human STAT2 knock‑in mouse to create an immunocompetent model showing enhanced susceptibility.
choices: D: Confers resistance or evades detection

citation.ref: Gorman et al., Cell Host Microbe (2018)

title: Dengue virus NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation
input: Dengue virus NS5 protein binds to human STAT2 and targets it for ubiquitin-mediated degradation, disrupting type I interferon signaling.
choices: D: Confers resistance or evades detection

citation.ref: Ashour et al., Journal of Virology (2009)

title: Hepatitis C virus NS3/4A protease cleaves MAVS
input: Hepatitis C virus NS3/4A serine protease cleaves the mitochondrial antiviral-signaling protein (MAVS), disabling RIG-I mediated interferon production.
choices: D: Confers resistance or evades detection
